fields.customer_persona: A broad starting audience for the Nexon: people comparing a compact SUV for daily use, family travel or a preferred driving setup. This is not evidence about the current buyer.
fields.decision_frame: We'll take a balanced look at the published equipment and trim choices, and you can steer us toward what matters to you.
fields.takeaway: The Nexon has standard safety equipment, different fuel and gearbox choices, and cabin features that depend on the selected trim.
fields.primary_outcome: A clear shortlist based on standard safety equipment and the cabin and driving setup of the selected trim.
supporting_outcomes: Published boot volumes separated by fuel type, with a personal luggage-fit check still to do
Cabin display and convenience choices tied to the documented trim
fields.do_not_recommend_if: If a must-have requirement is not covered by the supplied material, verify it before recommending a trim.
fields.advance: Choose Book Test Drive when you're ready to try the seats, visibility and gearbox for yourself.
fields.notes: Use manufacturer-stated specifications and preserve exact engine/trim conditions. Ground clearance is not a water-depth or obstacle-clearance guarantee. Exterior dimensions and boot litres do not prove passenger comfort or luggage fit. A test drive can help assess personal comfort and driving feel; it does not establish representative fuel economy. Confirm the selected variant, current on-road quote, finance approval and detailed ownership terms. Source-specific engine figures must not be converted or blended. Only the current approved registry may supply facts.

replacements.from: Buyers need assurance that their family is protected against unpredictable highway hazards and city traffic.
replacements.to: Buyers may want to examine published crash ratings and the safety equipment on their selected trim.

replacements.from: Waterlogged city streets, high speed breakers, and broken rural roads risk underbody scrapes.
replacements.to: Buyers may want the published ground-clearance figure, without treating it as a guarantee about road obstacles or water.

replacements.from: Compact SUVs often compromise boot space, especially when opting for dual-cylinder gas configurations.
replacements.to: Buyers may want to compare petrol/diesel and CNG boot figures, then check the fit of their own luggage.

replacements.from: Buyers want to understand official fuel efficiency figures across petrol, diesel, and CNG engines before deciding.
replacements.to: Buyers may want verified fuel-efficiency and ownership-cost information before choosing an engine.
